adoption_gates: All legs the consumer uses must be non-null; a null leg means the input was not measurable, and the consumer must keep its existing constant.
terminal_g_suggestion must be adopted only when long_run_growth.degraded is false.
Sector spreads stay with the consumer: adopt the LEVEL, keep the spread structure, and treat sector_loadings as information.
Re-run the MoS rank-correlation impact audit before and after adoption.

constants.note: Equity cost of capital LEVEL only. Sector SPREADS are preserved: the anchors publish loadings, never a replacement spread table.

degradation_reasons: erp: implied method configured but no equity aggregate is available at 'data/anchors/equity_aggregate.json'; MRI holds no equity data by design
erp_history: no ERP history file at data/anchors/erp_history.csv
gordon: cost of equity or growth unavailable; no justified multiple

The market-observed band requires a valuation panel (date, sector, forward multiple). MRI's local sector ETF file is price-only by construction, so no multiple can be derived from it; see docs/ANCHOR_METHODOLOGY.md §5.
panel: no valuation panel file at data/anchors/sector_multiple_panel.csv
known_findings: outputs/current_regime.json can carry a synthetic future `date` (observed 2031-08-01). The anchors avoid it by dating themselves from the stored observation history. Recorded here, deliberately NOT fixed in the anchor change.
rollback: Delete or rename the anchor JSON files: the consumer falls back to its own constants, which remain in the code unchanged.
The anchors are additive outputs; no MRI output schema changed, so no MRI rollback is required.
